_source: FIRST AGRI INC. 2026 Buyer Pitch (FA Series), PDF uploaded 2026-07-02
_note_currency: ✅解決済み（2026-08-18）：USD が基準。AUD = USD × 1.428 で全社統一。旧版は AUD を 1.451 で計算し、さらに FA001/FA002 に値上げ前の価格が入っていた。

skus.positioning: Flagship. Top sensory scores (umami, sweetness, aroma, water solubility). Use when the buyer explicitly wants top-tier ceremonial quality and price is secondary.
Engineered specifically for milk-based drinks (matcha latte). Water solubility 5/5. Use when the lead's stated use case is a latte menu.
Cost-optimized while still 100% Uji ichibancha ceremonial grade. DEFAULT RECOMMENDATION when the lead explicitly asks for both premium/Kyoto quality AND wholesale price competitiveness.
skus._process_correction: ⚠️2026-08-11 Rui確認：FA003 は石臼挽きではない。旧版の 'Stone-ground, two-step firing' は誤り。石臼挽きは FA001・FA002 のみ。

skus.positioning: Best price-to-flavor benchmark; nutty/milky profile. Use for volume-focused buyers who are open to non-Kyoto origin, or for multi-origin trial sample sets.
Lowest cost, vivid color at volume. Use for large-volume / cost-sensitive buyers, RTD beverage, ice cream, or bakery use cases.

internal_sample_codes._note: Organic-certified Kagoshima line, separate from the FA buyer-pitch series. All items: Organic cert + Certificate of Origin, Healthcare Certificate, COA, FDA. Terms: EXW, 100% down payment, USD/JPY bank transfer.

items._note: ⚠️在庫本体200kgのみ。小ロット専用・大口には出せない
在庫が厚い＝量販・有機ラインの主力
有機・ラテグレード。コスト重視のカリナリー枠

internal_sample_codes.volume_supply_note: Only Dg (4500kg) and AEc (2000kg) have stock depth for chain-scale supply; Df (600kg) and AFb (450kg) are premium/limited-tier only.

differentiators: Every SKU US FDA pesticide/contaminant tested
Flexible MOQ from 20kg per SKU, no minimum-container commitment

sample_request.turnaround: curated sample box + cupping notes + quote sheet within 2 business days

sku_selection_rules.recommend_secondary: FA002 if latte menu is mentioned

sku_selection_rules.if: lead's use case is explicitly a matcha latte menu

sku_selection_rules.if: lead wants top-tier flagship / quality-first, price secondary, small-mid volume
